name: Doomsday
description:
Deals unaspected damage with a potency of 350 to all enemies in a straight line.
Drain Touch Potency: 500
Potency scales with item level.
Consumes 10% of maximum HP when executed.
Additional Effect: Removes one beneficial status from target, with some exceptions when under the effect of Drain Touch
Additional Effect: Afflicts yourself with Doom
Duration: 10s
Effect is dispelled when HP is restored to full.
